title: Recording: Yes I’m Your Angel, Hard Times Are Over by John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1980
content:
Hit Factory, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono, Jack Douglas
Engineer: Lee DeCarlo

A recording session for John Lennon and Yoko Ono’s Double Fantasy album took place on 8 September 1980.

Between 8 and 11pm, Ono’s song ‘Yes, I’m Your Angel’ was re-recorded in 3/4 time, although the experiment was later abandoned. Afterwards Ono overdubbed her lead vocals onto ‘Hard Times Are Over’.

Page last updated: 18 May 2026
